title: The Echo of Kepler Reach
author: D. M. Ishikawa
blurb: August Fairweather, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
